title: sqlparse.split doesn't split after BEGIN...END block containing DROP TABLE IF EXISTS
spec:
This is the sqlparse library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests`.

```python
import sqlparse
sql = """CREATE TASK t1 AS
BEGIN
    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE temp1;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp1;
END;
EXECUTE TASK t1;"""
print(len(sqlparse.split(sql)))
```

Expected: 2 statements (the CREATE TASK ... END; and `EXECUTE TASK t1;`).
Actual: 1 statement (everything stays in one string).

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: The example splits into exactly 2 statements
Plain DROP TABLE IF EXISTS foo; SELECT 1; still splits into 2
